_comment: Single source of truth for which tools each subagent gets (issue #17).
scripts/permissions.py check: .claude/agents/<name>.md must list exactly these tools in its `tools:` frontmatter.
An agent file without `tools:` inherits every tool (start_run, finish_run, every MCP server), so `tools:` is required.
No agent gets `Agent`: a subagent can spawn its own subagents, which would escape this list.
Raters (open-coder, labeler, skeptic, context-classifier) get no file tools and no get_disagreements: labels/dump.sql holds every stored label, so `Read` would let a rater see other raters' labels.
Only the main session starts and finishes runs: it calls start_run, hands the run_id to the agent it delegates to, and calls finish_run after.
`may_write` mirrors the 'May write' column in CLAUDE.md; hooks (#33) use it. Agents with Write/Edit/Bash rely on those hooks and settings.json for path limits, since `tools:` can't hold path rules.
